pages.title: GreenWheel Vegan Food Truck - Fresh Plant-Based Meals on the Go
pages.html:
🌱 GreenWheel

Fresh Plant-Based Meals on the Go

GreenWheel brings delicious vegan food to your neighborhood every day of the week.

See This Week's Schedule

Where We Park This Week

Monday & Tuesday

Downtown Plaza

Main Street & 5th Avenue

11:00 AM – 8:00 PM

Wednesday & Thursday

Riverside Park

Park Drive near the Pavilion

12:00 PM – 9:00 PM

Friday & Saturday

Farmers Market District

Elm Street & Garden Lane

10:00 AM – 10:00 PM

Sunday

Community Commons

Central Hub, West End

11:00 AM – 7:00 PM

Our Menu

Every item is 100% plant-based, made fresh daily with locally-sourced ingredients.

Buddha Bowl Deluxe

$12.99

Quinoa, roasted vegetables, chickpeas, tahini dressing, and fresh greens.

Spiced Chickpea Wrap

$10.99

Crispy chickpeas, hummus, lettuce, tomato, and house-made spice blend in a soft tortilla.

Cashew Cream Pasta

$13.99

Linguine tossed with creamy cashew sauce, broccoli, garlic, and fresh basil.

Jackfruit Tacos (3)

$11.99

Pulled jackfruit seasoned with lime and cumin, topped with slaw and cilantro.

Falafel Plate

$12.99

Five golden falafel with tahini sauce, hummus, pita bread, and pickled vegetables.

Green Smoothie Bowl

$9.99

Spinach, mango, and coconut milk base topped with granola, berries, and coconut.

This Week's Specials

Monday Special

Miso Mushroom Burger

$9.99

Umami-packed portobello mushroom patty with caramelized onions and garlic aioli on a toasted bun. Available only on Mondays!

Wednesday Special

Thai Green Curry

$13.99

Coconut-based green curry with tofu, bamboo shoots, bell peppers, and basil. Served with jasmine rice. Available only on Wednesdays!

Friday Special

Crispy Tofu Sandwich

$11.99

Golden-fried tofu with crispy slaw, sriracha mayo, and pickled ginger on focaccia. Available only on Fridays!

Weekend Special

Chocolate Avocado Mousse

$5.99

Silky dark chocolate and creamy avocado dessert with fresh berries. Available Saturdays & Sundays!

Ready to Taste the Difference?

Find us at your favorite neighborhood spot this week and discover why GreenWheel is the best vegan food truck in town.

Questions? Call us at (555) 123-4567 or email hello@greenwheel.local
